gui.vc-audio-distance.cancel.tooltip: Discard every change made since this screen was opened.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.corners.no: No voice comes round a corner right now
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.corners.to: A voice behind a wall comes round through a nearby doorway or window: less muffled, and from that side. Like hearing someone from the next room through an open door.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.hint: The echo comes from the space around you; water and rain from where you and the speaker are.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.no_world: Join a world to see your surroundings.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.reverb.str: How loud the echo is compared to the voice.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.reverb.too: Voices echo in caves, halls and big rooms. The addon measures the space around you with rays: the bigger and more closed it is, the longer the echo. Open air has none.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.room.close: Enclosed %s, walls about %s bl. away: echo %s s
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.sound_phys: It already adds echo and underwater sound to voices, so ours stay off. Rain still works.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.water.tool: When your head or the speaker's is under water, voices become dull and quiet.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.water.unde: Your head is under water: every voice is dull and quiet
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.weather.ra: Rain: far voices are harder to hear
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.weather.th: Thunderstorm: far voices are much harder to hear
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.weather.to: Under the open sky, rain makes far voices quieter and a thunderstorm even more. Close voices stay clear.
gui.vc-audio-distance.falloff.tooltip:
How strongly the voice fades with distance.
100% = normal, 0% = same volume everywhere in range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.floor.tooltip:
Voices never get quieter than this, even at the edge of the range.
Scaled by each player's own volume, so muted players stay muted.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.corner.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the voice HUD sits in.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.mode.tooltip: A small panel on the screen: who is talking nearby, how far and from where, and while you talk how many players hear you. "While talking" shows it only when someone speaks. There is also a key for it in Controls.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.nobody_whisper: Nobody is close enough for a whisper
gui.vc-audio-distance.inspect.speaker: %s · %s bl. · %s
gui.vc-audio-distance.listen.tooltip: Plays a voice walking away from you along this curve, so you hear how it fades.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.door.tool: Doors and trapdoors (only when the ray hits the door itself).
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.leaves.to: Leaves let most of the sound through.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.liquid.to: Every block of liquid between you and the speaker.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.stone.too:
Stone, bricks, concrete, ores, metal – every dense block
that is not listed separately.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.thin.tool: Fences, gates, iron bars – mostly open.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.wool.tool: Wool and carpets – the best sound insulation.
gui.vc-audio-distance.materials.hint: How much one block muffles, compared to stone (100%).
Most of the loudness is gone soon after the full-volume distance,
then voices fade to silence at the edge. Tense and quiet.
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.inverse.tool:
How sound behaves in the open: loudness drops quickly at first,
then slowly, and fades out over the last quarter of the range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.label: Curve: %s
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.linear.toolt:
Simple Voice Chat's own curve: full volume up to the
full-volume distance, then a straight fade to silence.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.col.name: Player
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.empty: Nobody is within voice range right now.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.empty_hint: Players within earshot show up here: who is talking, how loud, and through which walls.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.no_world: Join a world to see who is nearby.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.server.non: Server: no addon (walls are muffled only on your side)
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.states_unk: Who has no voice chat or turned the sound off shows with Simple Voice Chat 2.6.1+ or the addon on the server.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.view.toolt: List: every player with distance, loudness and walls. Radar: a map seen from above, you in the middle looking up; the rings are the voice and whisper range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.atmospheric:
Voices fade fast and walls muffle strongly.
Made for hide-and-seek, horror and stealth maps.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.default.too:
Exactly what Simple Voice Chat does on its own:
full volume up to half the range, then a straight fade. No wall muffling.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.high_audibi:
Everyone stays understandable: gentle falloff,
25% floor at the edge, no wall muffling. Good for events.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.realistic.t:
Natural 1/r falloff, a quiet floor at the edge
and walls that muffle voices.
gui.vc-audio-distance.reference.tooltip:
Up to this distance voices play at full volume,
then they start to fade. Simple Voice Chat uses half the range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.reset.tooltip:
Restore the defaults: Simple Voice Chat's own curve with wall muffling at 60%.
Cancel still brings back what you had.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.apply.toolt:
This server suggests its own sound profile.
Apply copies it into your settings; you can still change or cancel it.
gui.vc-audio-distance.status.sound_physi: It already muffles voices through walls, so ours stays off.
gui.vc-audio-distance.status.unavailable: Wall muffling is not available in this build
Use the Fabric version for walls, the monitor and this screen.
gui.vc-audio-distance.strength.tooltip:
How much walls affect voices.
60% ≈ one stone wall: −8 dB, muffled above ~2.5 kHz.
gui.vc-audio-distance.summary.flat: Same volume everywhere up to %s bl.
gui.vc-audio-distance.title: Voice Distance
gui.vc-audio-distance.walls.hint: Sound bends around edges: a half-open doorway muffles less than a wall.
gui.vc-audio-distance.walls.preview_off: Wall muffling is off – preview of what it would do
gui.vc-audio-distance.walls.toggle.toolt:
Voices behind walls, doors and floors become quieter and muffled,
depending on what is in between.
gui.vc-audio-distance.whisper.tooltip:
Multiplies the falloff while someone whispers.
×1.00 = like normal speech, higher = whispers fade faster.
key.vc-audio-distance.toggle_hud: Voice HUD: off / while talking / always
message.vc-audio-distance.server_profile: [Voice Distance] This server uses its own sound profile while you play here. Your own settings return when you leave.
[Voice Distance] This server suggests a sound profile. Open the voice chat settings (V) → "Voice distance & walls…" to apply it.
message.vc-audio-distance.welcome.button: [Voice Physics] Voices now fade with distance and are muffled by walls. To tune it: voice chat settings (V) → "Voice distance & walls…".
message.vc-audio-distance.welcome.key: [Voice Physics] Voices now fade with distance and are muffled by walls. Press %s to tune it.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.vc-audio-: Shapes how Simple Voice Chat voices fade with distance and muffles them through walls. Client: live curve, wall preview, monitor. Server (optional): walls for players without the addon and a shared sound profile.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.vc-audio-dist: Voice distance curves and wall muffling for Simple Voice Chat.
